message.content:
Beneath the wide, unending sky,  
A ribbon of hope takes flight—  
A kite, a whisper against the wind,  
A dance of colors, bright.

It arcs like a silver arrow,  
Slicing through clouds so white,  
Its tail a flag of freedom,  
In the hush of morning light.

The string, a thread of longing,  
Pulls tight with every gust,  
Yet the kite, it holds its balance,  
In the air, it trusts.

Children laugh as it ascends,  
Their voices rise and blend,  
With the wind's own song, they sing,  
On this day, no end.

When the sun dips low, the kite descends,  
Softly landing on the grass,  
Its colors fade into the dusk,  
But memories will always last.

So let your heart be a kite,  
Let your dreams take flight,  
Hold onto the string of hope,  
And soar beyond the night.
